name: Philosophy Glossary
description: A philosophy glossary focused on terminology that requires specialized or context-sensitive translation, especially terms whose ordinary translations may be ambiguous, unstable, or inconsistent with established academic usage.
author: Jangtsorngnan

zh-CN.name: 哲学术语表
zh-CN.description: 哲学翻译术语库，主要收录古代和近代西方哲学主要流派当中，在一般翻译中容易出现歧义、译法漂移，或需要按照学术传统保持严格概念区分的术语。以学界主流译法为基础，不一一列举所有哲学词汇。
